title: Aromatic Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: Salty beef skewers with a cheese pull, perfect for a post-workout meal, featuring thai bird chili and confit tomato, sugar free friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the beef is cooking, mix the confit tomato and thai bird chili in a small bowl.
After the beef is cooked, brush the confit tomato mixture onto the skewers.
Top each skewer with shredded provolone cheese and return to the grill for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the cheese is melted and slightly browned.
